transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

Well... I suppose I just haven't been myself lately. My, um... my friend from choir passed away. Very suddenly. And since then... I don't know. Things are just harder. 

I get all worked up about phone calls I used to handle easy. Sometimes I just find myself crying over silly things, like the potluck lists. And I've... well, I've started missing church planning things. I never would have missed those before. So... I guess that's why I'm here.
How long has it been since your friend passed away?
It's been... just about a month ago. Um, yes. Everything was fine before that. It was really only after losing her like that... so suddenly... that I started falling apart with the church planning.
Do you find yourself enjoying things you used to like before your friend passed away?
I... I'm not really sure. I haven't really thought about it. I suppose I just haven't been doing much of anything lately to... to even know.
Do you feel guilty about your friend's death?
No... no, I don't think so. I mean, it was just... it was sudden. There was nothing anyone could do. So... no.
Are there things that you used to enjoy doing before your friend passed away that you still find pleasure in now?
I just... I don't really know. Like I said, I haven't been doing much of anything. I just sit at home mostly. So... I'm not sure.
Are there things that you still find pleasure in?
Not really. I... I just don't think I have a good answer for that right now. I haven't really noticed.
Do you feel like you're unable to experience pleasure in things?
I suppose... I don't know if "unable" is the word. I just... haven't really tried to do much of anything lately. It's hard to say when you're mostly just sitting around. I just don't know.
Do you feel like things that used to be fun are now not fun at all?
I'm... I don't know. Like I said, I haven't really been doing those things. So... I can't really say if they're fun or not.
Do you feel sad most of the day?
I... I don't know if sad is the right word. I'm not really paying attention to it, honestly. I just... kind of get through the day.
Do you feel like you've lost interest in things you used to enjoy?
I... well, it's like I've been saying. I haven't really tried to do much, so I couldn't tell you if the interest is gone or if I'm just... not doing them. I haven't thought about it.
Have you lost a significant amount of weight since your friend passed away?
I... I don't think so. I haven't really stepped on a scale lately to check. My clothes still seem to fit about the same, I guess. So... no, probably not.
Do you feel depressed most of the day?
I... I wouldn't really call it that. Depressed. I just... I wake up, and I get by. I'm not really sitting around analyzing my moods all day. It's just... quiet, I guess. I don't know.
Do you think you would enjoy doing things you used to like if you tried them now?
I don't... I really don't know. I haven't tried, so... it's hard to say. Maybe? I just haven't thought about it.
Do you think you would find pleasure in activities if you were to participate in them now?
I... I think that's kind of what you just asked me. Like I said, I really don't know. I haven't been doing much of anything, so... I just couldn't tell you.
How long have you been feeling this way, since your friend passed away or even before?
It's... it's been about a month. Ever since she... since she passed away. We sang in the choir together, so... yeah, about a month.
Do you feel sad most of the time, even when you're not thinking about your friend?

I... I don't really know. I try not to dwell on things too much. So I couldn't really say if it's all the time, or... what exactly I'm thinking about when it happens. I'm just trying to get through the days.
Do you feel like you have no interest in the things you used to do?
I... I don't really know if I have no interest. Like I said before, I just haven't been doing much. So... I'm not sure.
Do you feel like you have no interest in doing the things you used to enjoy?
I... I think you just asked me that. I really don't know. I'm just... not doing much of anything right now.
Have your symptoms been present every day since your friend passed away?
...I suppose so. It's been about a month now... since she died. We were in choir together. I haven't really been keeping track of every single day, but... yes, I guess it's been since then.
